sourceDescription: Going through a large crowded mall to take the train in Hong Kong. (binaural, please use headset for 3D effect) I made this recording while I was walking through a large crowded shopping-mall (called New Town Plaza, and located in Sha Tin, Hong Kong) to take the KCR (train). First, I’ll go into the big mall and you’ll hear many people walking and talking in this large place. Then you will hear the beeps of the machines validating the passengers’ travel cards, and the escalators.
